mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals active monetary easing, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of months with FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.0%, it signals severe labor market distress that reduces consumer spending and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances with both HOUST and RSAFS declining, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) with strong labor markets (UNRATE < 5.0%), S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to dual pressure of higher rates and sustained growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances meeting trigger condition, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening real economic activity, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of months with INDPRO decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 550.0, it signals housing sector weakness that reduces consumer wealth and spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 550.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month declines in employment (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances with PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
